ACKNOWLEDGMENT OF LENDERRIGHTSFORSUBORDINATION Borrower/ Lawrence Disalvo LENDER: CTBC Bank Corp. (USA) Landlord: (a/k/a Lawrence G. DiSalvo) 17851-A3 Colima Road Camille Disalvo City of Industry, CA 91748 129 Fontaine Court MonroeTownship,NJ 08831 8912 3rd Avenue GoGoKidz Inc. Premises: Tenant: Brooklyn, NY 11209 (d/b/aPeekabooIseeU) 8912 3rd Avenue Brooklyn, NY 11209 THE UNDERSIGNED, being the parties to that certain Lease Agreement made as of July 15, 2024 ("Lease"), affecting demised premises located at 8912 3rd Avenue, Brooklyn, New York ("Premises"), more particularly described in Schedule A annexed hereto and forming a part hereof, hereby warrant and represent the following in connection therewith: 1. Tenant is a tenant occupying the Premises pursuant to the Lease, which term will expire July 31,2029 (plus applicable options to renew exercisable solely by Tenant). 2. Tenant and Landlord jointly and severally acknowledge and accept that, pursuant to express provision of the Lease, the Lease itself, and the rights and interest of Tenant and Landlord thereunder, are subject and subordinate to any mortgage lien that now exists, or may be given later by Landlord with respect to the Premises. As such, the parties hereto affirm the subordination of the Lease to the $270,000 mortgage lien created as of April 7, 2025 ("Mortgage"), encumbering the Premises, and held by CTBC Bank Corp. (USA) ("Lender"), to be recorded with the New York City Register's Office ("City Register") - with such subordination extending to the respective rights and interests of Tenant and Landlord under the Lease. 3. Tenant and Landlord jointly and severally acknowledge and accept that, as further security for the Mortgage, Landlord has made an assignment of all rents paid under the Lease in favor of Lender, as evidenced by a Collateral Assignment of Leases &Rents executed of even date with the Mortgage,to be recorded with the CityRegister. 4. Tenant and Landlord jointly and severally agree to provide prompt, written notice to Lender, as holder of the Mortgage, of any default of Tenant or Landlord, as the case may be, in the obligations of such party under the Lease, and to provide reasonable opportunity to cure such default. -1-

5. Tenant and Landlord jointly and severally grant to Lender the right to take possession and dispose of, or remove, the Collateral in the event of Tenant's default under the Lease, and/or Landlord's default under the Note, Mortgage and/or any other agreement executed in connectionwith theNote. 6. Tenant and Landlord are aware that this Acknowledgment is made to induce Lender to grant the Loan to Landlord, and that Lender is relying upon the veracity of the statements made hereinto do so. 7. Tenant and Landlord are aware that this Acknowledgment may be recorded with the City Register at Lender's option; and Landlord agrees to pay the requisite recording fees therefor upon Lender's demand. 8. This Acknowledgment shall be governed by, construed in accordance with, and enforceable under the laws of the State of New York (without regard to the conflict of law rules). 9. This Acknowledgment shall be binding upon Tenant and Landlord, their respective heirs and estates, successors and assigns, as the case may be. If Tenant or Landlord consists of more than one person or entity, the obligations and liabilities of each such person hereunder are joint and several.
